description: This file defines the interface for semihosting APIs, including enums for instructions and open modes, and function prototypes for semihosting operations such as file I/O, console I/O, and system calls, based on ARM and RISC-V conventions.

methods.name: semihost_exec
methods.description: Manually execute a semihosting instruction with specified instruction code and arguments.

methods.name: semihost_poll_in
methods.description: Read a byte from the console input.

methods.name: semihost_poll_out
methods.description: Write a byte to the console output.

methods.name: semihost_open
methods.description: Open a file on the host system with specified path and mode.

methods.name: semihost_flen
methods.description: Get the length of a file.

methods.name: semihost_seek
methods.description: Seek to an absolute position in a file.

methods.name: semihost_read
methods.description: Read data from a file into a buffer.

methods.name: semihost_write
methods.description: Write data from a buffer into a file.
